note: Player bios written by Darren Young. Keyed on shirt number, because the source and the club's squad sheet do not always spell a name the same way.

manager.name: Nick Green
manager.bio: Nick, a former Kettering Town midfielder re-joined The Poppies in November 2025 as assistant manager to Liam McDonald. When McDonald stood down as Poppies boss in early August 2026 Nick took over the role of manager. The Latimer Park hotseat will be his first managerial role after having spells as Liam McDonald's assistant at Redditch United, Rushall Olympic and Stourbridge.

1.name: Paul White
1.bio: Paul first joined The Poppies in September 2016 from Accrington Stanley and went on to make over 150 apperances between the posts at Latimer Park. He was a key member of the 2019 Southern League Premier Division title winning side. Paul left in the summer of 2020 and joined Hereford before having spells with St Ives Town, Peterborough Sports, Coalville Town and Rushall Olympic. Paul arrived for his second spell with The Poppies in June 2025 but in the first game of the 2025/26 season he suffered a broken wrist that kept him out for over six months. Paul will be looking to pass 200 apperances for The Poppies during the 2026/27 season

2.name: Blaine Rowe
2.bio: Blaine arrived at Latimer Park in November 2025 joining from league rivals Stourbridge where he had played under Poppies boss Liam McDonald. The right-back went on to have a fantastic season playing a major part in the push for a play-off place. He began his career with Coventry City and had two loan spells in Scotland with Ayr United and Falkirk. Following his release from Coventry Blaine joined Darlington and had short loan spells with Barwell and Mickleover in his time with The Quakers. Blaine moved on to Hednesford Town and it was from The Pitmen Liam McDonald signed him for Stourbridge.

3.name: Aaron Powell
3.bio: Aaron returned to Latimer Park in July 2026 re-joining The Poppies from Peterborough Sports where he played 28 times in National League North last season. Aaron had a highly successful loan spell with The Poppies in the 2024/25 season where he played 50 times and won supporters player of the season on loan from Peterborough United. Aaron spent Six years at Peterborough United enjoying loan spells with Welling United, Bishop's Stortford and King's Lynn Town during that time.

4.name: Jack Newell
4.bio: Jack arrived at Latimer Park in June 2026 from league rivals Bromsgrove Sporting where he spent five seasons making 159 appearances. He began his career with Northampton Town but left Sixfields without making a first team appearance although he did have a loan spell with Corby Town. Spells with Barwell and Redditch United followed before he joined Bromsgrove in the summer of 2001. In his first season at The Victoria Ground Jack had a loan spell with Highgate United.

5.name: Tom Leak
5.bio: Tom is a imposing central defender who joined The Poppies in June 2026 from Chester where he played over 30 times in National League North during the 2025/26 season. He began his career with Walsall and whilst with the Saddlers he enjoyed loan spells with Salisbury City and Bath City. On leaving Walsall he joined Kidderminster Harriers and spent time on loan to Alfreton Town. Tom left Kiddy and joined Boston United where he was part of the Pilgrims squad that won promotion to the National League before heading to Chester, first on loan before signing full time in July 2025.

6.name: Harvey Peters
6.bio: Harvey is a tall, strong central defender who arrived at Latimer Park in late March 2026 from AFC Sudbury. He played twice against The Poppies prior to his move from The Suds and impressed manager Liam McDonald. He began his career with Watford playing in their Under 18's before dropping into non league football joining Wroxham. Spells with Brentwood and Lowestoft Town followed before he made the move to Sudbury in December 2025.

7.name: Lawson D'Ath
7.bio: An experienced midfielder Lawson arrived at Latimer Park in June 2026 from Hereford where he spent the previous two seasons making over 60 appearances in National League North. Lawson began his career with Reading making one first team appearance for The Royals and also having loan spells with Yeovil Town, Cheltenham Town, Exeter City and Dagenham & Redbridge. On his release from Reading Lawson joined Northampton Town and was part of The Cobblers Division Three title winning squad under Chris Wilder in 2016. After leaving Sixfield he had spells at Luton Town, MK Dons and a second spell with Yeovil. After over 200 football league appearances Lawson joined Banbury United in July 2023 and after one season with Banbury he joined Hereford.

8.name: Bayley Brown
8.bio: Bayley is a 6ft 5' central midfielder who arrived at Latimer Park in July 2026 from Enfield Town who he played 37 times for in National League South last season. Began his career with Tottenham Hotspur but never made it to the first team squad and following his release from White Hart Lane he joined Northwood. Spells with Staines Town, Harrow Borough, Hendon and Beaconsfield followed before he made the jump up to the National Leagues joining St Albans City. Two seasons with Hemel Hempstead Town followed before he made the switch to Enfield where in two seasons he played over 60 games. With his size he is a real asset to any team in both boxes.

9.name: Eddie Panter
9.bio: Eddie, a pacy striker arrived at Latimer Park in late November 2025 for an undisclosed fee from Bedford Town. Eddie was part of The Eagles squad that won the Southern League Premier Division title in the 2024/25 season. He went on to have a remarkable second half to the 25/26 season for The Poppies scoring 19 goals in 25 apperances making him one of the most feared strikers in the division. Eddie began his career with Bugbrooke St Michaels playing in their first team aged just 16 and has also had spells with Harborough Town, Wellingborough Town and Biggleswade Town.

10.name: Shaun Jeffers
10.bio: Shaun is a vastly experienced striker who joined The Poppies in June 2026 from Bedford Town. He began his career with Coventry City making six appearances in the Championship and also had loan spells with Cheltenham Town, Cambridge United and Tamworth whilst with The Sky Blues. Shaun moved on to Peterborough United then to Newport County before a spell with another football league club Yeovil Town. After leaving The Glovers Shaun's non-league journey began as he enjoyed spells with Woking, Chelmsford City, Boreham Wood and Brackley Town before he joined St Albans City. Shaun spent five seasons at Clarence Park and in that time became one of the most prolific strikers in National League South scoring 98 times in 195 appearances. After he left St Albans he joined his hometown club Bedford Town before ending the 2025/26 season on loan at Peterborough Sports.

11.name: Theo Alexandrou
11.bio: Theo is a pacey, energetic forward who arrived at Latimer Park in July 2026 from St Ives Town. He began his career with Stevenage where he had loan spells with Cambridge City, Potters Bar Town, Cheshunt and St Ives Town. It was in his spell with The Ives he really impressed and following his release from Stevenage he joined them on a permanent deal in the summer of June 2024. But after only two months back at Westwood Road Theo was snapped up by National League South side Dorking Wanderers. He struggled to hold down a regular place in the Dorking side and had spells on loan with Welling United and Wingate & Finchley. Theo returned to St Ives for a third spell in June 2025.

12.name: Lewis Coyle
12.bio: Lewis arrived at Latimer Park in November 2025 on loan from Bedford Town, a move that was made permanent in March 2026. A set play specialist Lewis quickly became a fans favourite with his displays. He began his career at Kidlington before spending five seasons with Oxford City prior to his spell at Bedford

13.name: Jason Alexander
13.bio: Jason first joined The Poppies from Belper Town in September 2024 as cover for the suspended Dan Jezeph and put in a man of the match performance on his debut against Cleethorpes Town. Jason also played in the live FA Cup 2nd Round clash with Doncaster Rovers before leaving Latimer Park for Matlock Town. But after Paul White suffered an injury in the first game of the 2025/26 season Jason returned and went on to play 30 times before injury saw him lose his place to the fit again White. Jay began his career with Chesterfield before spells with a number of non league clubs including Boston United, Loughborough Dynamo and Corby Town.

14.name: Michael Gyasi
14.bio: Michael is a pacy forward who arrived at Latimer Park on the eve of the 2026/27 season joining on loan from Bedford Town.

15.name: Tai Fleming
15.bio: Tai is a strong no nonsense defender who arrived at Latimer Park in July 2026 from King's Lynn Town where he made 33 appearances in National League North last season. Tai began his career with Yeovil Town and then moved on to King's Lynn Town for his first spell with The Linnetts. Tai spent a season on loan at Lowestoft Town winning manager's player of the season before returning to Lynn. Joined Banbury United ahead of the 2023-2024 season where he played in every game and captained the team at 21 years old. He received manager's player of the season and scored against The Poppies in the final game of the 2024/25 season at Latimer Park. Returned to King's Lynn for an undisclosed fee in July 2025.

16.name: Ryan Haynes
16.bio: Ryan is a vastly experienced left-back who arrived at Latimer Park in June 2026 from Brackley Town. Northampton born he is a player with over 250 football league appearances to his name. Began his career with Coventry City (78 appearances) and in his time with The Sky Blues he had a spell on loan with Cambridge United (10 appearances). He moved to Shrewsbury Town in June 2018 for an undisclosed fee and went on to make 16 appearances. In July 2019 Newport County paid an undisclosed fee for Ryan's services and he went on to spend three years with The Exiles playing 103 times. In June 2022 Ryan moved to Northampton Town and was part of The Cobblers squad that won promotion from League Two in 2023. In July 2024 Ryan moved to Cheltenham Town making 13 appearances before he joined Brackley Town in July 2025 playing 16 times in the National League last season.

17.name: Ismael Fatadjo
17.bio: Ish arrived at Latimer Park in July 2025 joining from Leiston and went on to have an exellent first season for The Poppies. A player with high energy a wrist injury suffered in pre-season delayed his Kettering career but once fit he went on to me a major part in Liam McDonald's side that made the play-offs. He began his career with Gorleston then moved on to Wroxham before a spell in Portugal with Moncarapachense before returning to England and joining King's Lynn Town. A return to Gorleston came before he joined Leiston where he first came to the attention of The Poppies.

18.name: Will Van Lier
18.bio: Will joined The Poppies on a permanent deal in July 2026 having spent the final two months of the 2025/26 season with the club on loan from King's Lynn Town. A skilful and tidy midfielder Will impressed in his loan spell where he scored a vital goal in a home victory over Real Bedford. Will started his career with Peterborough United featuring for The Posh first team in the football league trophy. He left London Road in 2024 and joined Peterborough Sports where he played 39 times in National League North. In July 2025 Will joined King's Lynn Town playing 8 times before joining Leamington on loan for 3 months prior to joining The Poppies on loan in February 2026.

19.name: Kai Fifield
19.bio: Kai joined The Poppies in August 2024 having impressed whilst on trial in pre-season. A forward with skill and flair his career at Latimer Park started well but an unfortunate injury saw him face a spell out injured. Prior to joining he had a brief spell with St Ives Town and has also featured for Wellingborough Whitworths. During the 2025/26 Kai spent a month on loan with Quorn where he scored three times in five games. 20 21 22 23 24
